name: Wave Warp
description: Bends the layer with a sine wave: Spacing sets how many waves cross it, Magnitude how far they push, Angle the direction the waves run and Warp Angle the direction they push. Screen Space sizes the waves to the screen instead of the layer. Cross Magnitude adds a second wave, sized by Cross Spacing, that runs along Warp Angle and pushes along Angle. Origin Screen Bottom Left measures the waves from that corner of the screen on its short side, and Phase then slides them along.
